impact: A soft print, but commentary says it may not stop a Bank of Japan hike in December; a BoJ hike would firm the yen and can tighten global liquidity for high-multiple tech like NBIS and PLTR.
summary: Japan's real GDP fell 0.1% annualised in Q3 (flat q/q) vs about +0.3% expected. Private consumption fell 0.3% q/q, imports rose 2.5% and exports fell 0.2%, while business investment rose 1.6%. The GDP deflator rose 2.4% y/y.
title: Japan Q3 GDP shrinks 0.1% annualised, missing forecasts for growth
